'''Seth Van Winkle''' (DeckTech handle '''Ooryl''')<ref name="dt-24316">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24316 Seth's Mad Huntdown Deck], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 10 July 2002).
